cities.name: Prague

interests.name: History & Castles 🏰
interests.description: Medieval fortifications, Gothic towers and panoramic European viewpoints around the castle district.

interests.name: Old Town Culture 🏛️
interests.description: Atmospheric squares, Renaissance façades, narrow alleys and legendary architectural icons.

interests.name: Riverside Views 🌉
interests.description: Vltava bridges, shimmering reflections and postcard-perfect sunset scenery.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Czech classics like dumplings, potato soups, trdelník pastries and comforting sweet-baked dishes — warm, hearty and perfect for a full sightseeing day.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Prague Castle District: Walk through courtyards, castle walls and panoramic viewpoints above the Vltava. → ⛪ St. Vitus Cathedral: Gothic masterpiece glowing with stained glass. → 🧱 Golden Lane: Tiny medieval houses with a fairytale atmosphere. → ☕ Coffee in Malá Strana. Afternoon: 🌉 Charles Bridge: Classic Prague views and statues. → 🕰️ Old Town Square: Lively historic heart. → ✨ Astronomical Clock: Famous hourly show. → 🍽️ Lunch: Dumplings, soups, pastries or veggie-friendly Czech comfort food. Sunset: 🌅 Letná Park or Vltava Promenade. Night: 🌃 Old Town evening walk: Soft lights, calm streets and dessert spots near the river.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms on Petřín Hill.
☕ Outdoor cafés in Old Town squares.
🌉 Riverside paths glowing in soft spring light.
🌊 Breezy riverside promenades along the Vltava.
🍦 Ice cream around Charles Bridge and Old Town.
🌳 Shady terraces at Letná Park.
🍁 Warm-toned foliage on Castle Hill.
🥐 Cozy pastries in famous Prague cafés.
🏛️ Museum afternoons at the National Gallery or Jewish Museum.
🎄 Old Town Square Market.
✨ Wenceslas Square holiday lights.
🏰 Prague Castle winter scenery.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚇 Metro is the fastest way between major sites.
🚋 Trams offer scenic routes across the city.
🚶 Old Town and Castle District are best explored on foot.
📱 Use ‘PID Lítačka’ app for tickets and real-time schedules.

cities.name: Brno

Afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town Streets: Explore lively squares and façades. → 🕰️ Brno Astronomical Clock on Náměstí Svobody. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian options. Sunset: 🌅 Terrace viewpoints near Špilberk or park benches around Lužánky. Night: 🌃 Old Town & Center: Student bars, craft pubs and relaxed evening vibes.

cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Krumlov Castle: Explore courtyards, historic halls and gardens above the river. → 🌉 Castle Tower: Iconic panoramic views over red rooftops. → 🏛️ Old Town Walk: Narrow lanes, arched bridges and artisan shops. → ☕ Coffee by the Vltava River. Afternoon: 🎨 Egon Schiele Art Center: Atmospheric exhibitions in a historic building. → 🌊 Riverside photo paths along the town curve. → 🍽️ Lunch: Bohemian dumplings, soups or sweet pastries. Sunset: 🌅 Castle Gardens: Magical golden-hour views over the rooftops. Night: 🌃 Lantern-lit Old Town: Peaceful cobblestone streets and glowing river reflections.

cities.full_day: Morning: 🏭 Dolní Vítkovice: Explore massive steel structures, blast furnaces and industrial walkways. → 👀 Bolt Tower: Glass viewing deck with 360° city views. → ☕ Coffee in an industrial-style café nearby. Afternoon: 🏙️ Masaryk Square: Colorful façades, fountains and a lively urban center. → 🌳 Komenského Sady: Large riverside park perfect for cooling off and relaxing. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian bowls. Sunset: 🌅 Bolt Tower or Slezskoostravský hrad: Golden light over dramatic industrial silhouettes. Night: 🌃 Stodolní Street (chill zones): Dessert cafés, easygoing bars and creative night corners.

Afternoon: 🌿 Smetana Park or Bezruč Gardens: Shady river paths and garden walks. → 🎨 Olomouc Museum of Art: Classic to modern exhibitions. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian meals. Sunset: 🌅 Cathedral Hill viewpoints around St. Wenceslas Cathedral. Night: 🌃 Old Town Lights: Calm evening stroll among fountains and pastel façades.
